cards.back: An object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion unless acted upon by an external force.
Velocity is the rate of change of displacement with respect to time. It's a vector quantity.

cards.front: What is the formula for Force?
cards.back: F = ma (Force equals mass times acceleration)
Energy possessed by an object due to its motion. KE = ½mv²
The rate of change of velocity with respect to time.

cards.front: What is the SI unit of force?

cards.back: Energy stored in an object due to its position or configuration.
The product of an object's mass and velocity. p = mv
Work is done when a force causes displacement. W = F × d
The rate at which work is done. P = W/t

cards.front: What is the Law of Conservation of Energy?
cards.back: Energy cannot be created or destroyed, only transformed from one form to another.
The change in momentum of an object. Impulse = F × t
The force that keeps an object moving in a circular path.
The rate of change of angular displacement with respect to time.
The rotational equivalent of force. τ = r × F
